_readme: This file is SignBridge's verified ISL reference video library.
VERIFICATION PROCESS (done honestly, no invented data):
1. Fetched https://www.youtube.com/@ISLRTC and the /videos tab directly.
Both are client-rendered by YouTube: no individual video IDs, titles,
or watch URLs were recoverable this way, only page chrome/nav links.
This was the expected, honestly-reported outcome.
2. Fetched ISLRTC's own official site (islrtc.nic.in). It links its real
YouTube channel (youtube.com/channel/UC3AcGIlqVI4nJWCwHgHFXtg) and a
real playlist (list=PLFjydPMg4Daoq83bOFHLos3RmcAbfP1vF, title
'ISLRTC News', confirmed via YouTube's oembed endpoint, author the
real @ISLRTC channel). The playlist page itself is also client
rendered, so individual video IDs inside it were not recoverable.
3. Found two NCERT CIET pages describing a 'Basic Indian Sign Language
Course' developed by NCERT in collaboration with ISLRTC
(ciet.ncert.gov.in/activity/isl2026 and /activity/biSL). Both pages
are server-rendered and list real youtube.com/watch?v=... URLs, one
per course day, each with a day/topic label.
4. Verified every single one of the 10 resulting video IDs individually
via https://www.youtube.com/oembed?url=...&format=json, which
returns real JSON (title, author_name, thumbnail_url) for any public
YouTube video without needing JS rendering. All 10 returned valid,
real, non-empty responses. Exact fetched title/author/thumbnail for
each is recorded in its entry below as verifiedTitle/attribution/
thumbnailUrl. verifiedViaMethod is 'oembed' for all of them.
HONEST LIMITATIONS:
- These are 10 full ISL course session recordings (each roughly a
themed lesson), not 10 individual single-word sign clips. SignBridge
does not have verified single-word ISL sign clips at this time.
- The real uploading channels are 'NCERT OFFICIAL' / 'NCERT Events' and
'PM eVidya ISL 31', not the ISLRTC channel itself, even though the
course was developed in collaboration with ISLRTC (stated on the
source ciet.ncert.gov.in pages). Attribution below names the real
verified channel for each video, and notes the ISLRTC collaboration.
- category assignment below is an honest best-effort grouping by lesson
topic (the real fetched title), it is not a claim that the video is
only about that one topic.
- explanation text is written in SignBridge's own words based on the
real fetched title and the source page's day/topic label, not
fabricated beyond that.
